summary: Frontend-only E2E testing of dark-mode institutional crypto trading terminal against production URL. Executed all 10 requested scenarios (page load, order book, trade tape, candle chart interval toggle, market switching + localStorage persistence, stress panel volatility modes, spike up/down, persist toggle, add market, error overlays, responsive at 1280x720). All functional flows PASS. No console errors, no runtime error overlay detected.

test_results.order_book: PASS - 10 ask rows, 10 bid rows, 1 spread row present; asks priced above bids (screenshot: top ask 65,517.81, top bid 65,321.82); values update continuously
test_results.trade_tape: PASS - trade-row count grew from 18 to 28 within 5s; trade-count text shows 'N prints'; rows show timestamp/symbol/BUY|SELL/size/price
test_results.candle_chart: PASS - candle-chart contains multiple canvases (lightweight-charts v5 rendered); interval-5s-btn and interval-1s-btn both toggle without runtime errors
test_results.market_selector_switch: PASS - switching to ETH-USD updates header (mid=3,494.39), trade rows show ETH-USD symbol, order book updates
test_results.market_persistence: PASS - after page reload, market-selector still shows ETH-USD (localStorage persistence works)
test_results.stress_volatility: PASS - volatile/calm/normal buttons update volatility-badge accordingly (badge text 'volatile'/'calm'/'normal', displayed uppercase via CSS)
test_results.spike: PASS - spike DOWN dropped mid from 65,439.10 -> 64,207.94 (~1.9%); spike UP recovered to 65,330.24; spike-persist-switch toggles
test_results.add_market: PASS - added QA2515-USD, drawer closed (implicitly), header switched to new symbol (mid=7.184), success toast 'QA2515-USD listed @ 7.207' visible, symbol appears in dropdown
test_results.error_overlays: PASS - no console errors, no Runtime Error overlay, no .error/[class*=error] elements
test_results.responsive_1280x720: PASS - layout remains usable, no broken panels

critical_code_review_comments: Volatility badge display text: DOM contains lowercase ('volatile'/'calm'/'normal') and relies on CSS uppercase transform; assertion needs case-insensitive matching. Cosmetic only.

Playwright reports 'Element is outside of the viewport' on Radix Sheet drawer buttons despite being visually in-viewport at 1920x1080 (likely due to CSS transform/animation on the Sheet). Workaround: JS-based element.click(). Consider adding data-state stability or using pointer-events settling to make E2E automation more robust. Not a user-facing bug.
seed_data_creation: Added market QA2515-USD via UI stress panel (in-memory, will persist until backend restart)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend fully validated against production URL. Backend from iteration_1 was 21/21. If retesting drawer buttons via Playwright, use JS click (element.click() via page.evaluate) instead of Locator.click() because Radix Sheet transform confuses viewport check. Added symbols (QA*) accumulate until backend restart.
